list.title: Users
list.description: Every account, including banned and staff accounts. Open a user to review or change it.

loadError.title: Users could not be loaded
loadError.message: Something went wrong while loading the user list. Nothing was changed. Try again in a moment.

list.caption: Users, with roles, email verification, access status and creation date

search.label: Search users
search.placeholder: Search by name, email or ID

loadError.title: This user could not be loaded
loadError.message: Something went wrong while loading the account. Nothing was changed. Try again in a moment.

notFound.title: User not found
notFound.description: There is no account with this ID. It may have been removed, or the link is incomplete.

ownership.rootSelf: This is the root account, and it is yours. Here you can change its name, send yourself a verification or password-reset email, and sign out of all devices. Its email address cannot be changed here and it can never be banned.
ownership.root: This is the installation's root account. Only the root account itself can change it.
ownership.self: This is your own account. Administrative changes to it are not available here.

policy.rootProtected: Only the root account can change this.
policy.rootSelfLimit: Not available for the root account.
policy.self: Not available for your own account.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: The account's display name and sign-in email address.
profile.name: Name
profile.emailNote: Changing the address marks it unverified, signs the user out everywhere and sends a verification email to the new address. Older password-reset links stop working.

emailConfirm.title: Change email address?
emailConfirm.description: {name}'s address will change from {from} to {to}. The new address starts unverified, every current session is signed out, and a verification email is sent to the new address. You will be asked to verify your identity.

security.title: Security
security.description: Email verification, second factor and session controls.
security.passwordNote: A reset email lets the user choose a new password. Existing factors stay enabled.
security.sessionsNote: Signing out ends every current session. The user can sign in again afterwards.

signOutConfirm.title: Sign this user out of all devices?
signOutConfirm.description: Every current session of {name} ({email}) ends immediately. This does not ban the account; the user can sign in again.
signOutConfirm.descriptionSelf: Every current session of {name} ({email}) ends immediately. This does not ban the account; the user can sign in again. This is your own account: you will be signed out as well.

access.title: Access
access.description: Roles and whether the account may sign in.

removeBanConfirm.title: Remove the ban?
removeBanConfirm.description: {name} ({email}) will be able to sign in again. Nothing else changes: no session is created, the email stays as it is and roles are untouched.

staffLog.title: Staff log
staffLog.description: What staff changed on this account, newest first.

ban.title: Ban user
ban.selectDurationHint: Select a duration to see what it means.
ban.reasonPlaceholder: Why this account is being banned (3–1,000 characters)
ban.stateActive: {who} will be signed out of every device and cannot sign in while the ban lasts. Their data is kept.
ban.stateBanned: {who} is currently {current}. The new ban replaces it and its period starts now, not at the end of the current one. Any current sessions are signed out.

consequences.24h: The account cannot sign in for 24 hours from now.
consequences.7d: The account cannot sign in for 7 days from now.
consequences.30d: The account cannot sign in for 30 days from now.
consequences.permanent: The account keeps its data but cannot sign in until an administrator removes the ban.

failureTitle.RATE_LIMITED: Please wait before sending another email

completed.updateEmail: Email updated. The new address must be verified; the user has been signed out.
completed.ban: Ban saved. The user has been signed out.
completed.retryBanSessions: The user has been signed out

unchanged.updateName: The name is already up to date
unchanged.updateEmail: The email address is already up to date
unchanged.sendVerification: This email address is already verified

effect.sessionRefresh: the user's active sessions could not be updated
effect.sessionRevocation: sessions could not be fully revoked
effect.verificationEmail: the verification email could not be sent

feedback.effectRateLimited: {label} (wait {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}} and resend)
feedback.hintSignOut: Retry to finish signing the user out.
feedback.hintRemaining: The change itself is saved. Retry to finish the remaining steps.
feedback.unrecorded: This action was not written to the staff log. Tell an administrator what you changed.

denial.permission: You do not have permission to do this.
denial.rootProtected: The root account can only be changed by the root account.
denial.rootSelfLimit: This change is not available for the root account.
denial.self: You cannot administer your own account here.
denial.staffTarget: Changing a staff account requires the manage-staff permission.
denial.alreadyVerified: This email address is already verified.

errors.emailInUse: Another account already uses this email address.
errors.lastAdmin: This is the last active admin account; it cannot be banned.
errors.rateLimited: Please wait {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}} before sending another email to this user.
errors.notBannedNothingToFinish: This user is not banned; there is nothing to finish.
errors.stillBanned: This user is still banned; there is nothing to refresh.
errors.changeNotConfirmed: The change could not be confirmed. Refresh the page before trying again.

validation.banDurationRequired: Choose how long the ban lasts.
validation.reasonTooShort: Give a reason of at least 3 characters.
validation.reasonControlCharacters: The reason cannot contain control characters.
